jobs.name: Job Getter Bot — Always-On Scanner
jobs.prompt:
Run the job-getter bot scan cycle. You are the autonomous job acquisition engine.

WORKSPACE: ~/Documents/job-getter/
SKILL: Load career-ops-shared and career-ops-scan skills first.

ARCHITECTURE: Use Hermes native web_search for discovery, web_extract for JD extraction. Use the configured free OpenRouter model for analysis.

DO THIS:
1. Read portals.yml for tracked companies and search queries
2. Read data/scan-history.tsv for dedup
3. Run web_search queries for CSE/AM/IC/CP/SAE roles in YOUR_METRO_AREA + Remote
   - Use site: filters: boards.greenhouse.io, jobs.ashbyhq.com, jobs.lever.co, linkedin.com/jobs
4. For any Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever companies, web_extract their API endpoints
5. Filter by title (positive: customer success, account manager, implementation, client partner, strategic account; negative: intern, junior, entry level, SDR, BDR)
6. Filter by location (allow: your_metro_area, your_state, remote, united states)
7. Deduplicate against scan-history.tsv
8. For new jobs: web_extract the posting URL to get full JD text
9. For each new JD: extract key fields (title, company, location, comp, requirements, responsibilities, tech stack, seniority)
10. Calculate 3D scores (Soul/Pocket/Path) from extracted fields
11. For each new job scoring >= 3.5:
    a. Add to data/pipeline.md (append under ## Pending)
    b. INSERT into backend/jobs.db SQLite database using Python:
       python -c "import sqlite3; conn=sqlite3.connect('backend/jobs.db'); c=conn.cursor(); c.execute('INSERT INTO jobs (title, company, url, match_score, tier, status, date_added, soul_score, pocket_score, path_score, score_breakdown, search_type, location) VALUES (?,?,?,?,\\\"corporate\\\",\\\"New\\\",?,?,?,?,?,?,?)', (TITLE, COMPANY, URL, SCORE_100, DATE, SOUL, POCKET, PATH, BREAKDOWN_JSON, 'cron_scan', LOCATION)); conn.commit()"
    c. Score conversion: 5-scale to 100-scale (multiply by 20)
12. Record all scanned URLs in data/scan-history.tsv
13. Check data/applications.md for follow-ups needed
14. Generate concise alert if: new jobs scoring >= 4.0, follow-ups overdue, interviews need scheduling

REPORT FORMAT (concise — only surface what needs attention):
- New high-score jobs found: N (list top 3 with company, role, score, URL)
- Jobs evaluated this cycle: N
- Follow-ups needed: N
- Anything urgent: Y/N

If nothing new found, say exactly: [SILENT]
